#[cfg_attr(any(unknown, feature = "disabled"), allow(unused))]
mod nested {
    #![allow(unused)]
    #![cfg(unknown)]
    #[allow(unused)]
    #[cfg(unknown)]
    pub struct Holder {
        #[cfg(unknown)]
        #[allow(unused)]
        pub field: u8,
    }
    pub struct Tuple(#[cfg(unknown)] pub u8);
    #[cfg(unknown)]
    pub enum Choice {
        #[cfg(unknown)]
        One,
    }
    #[cfg(unknown)]
    pub trait Contract {
        #[cfg(unknown)]
        #[allow(unused)]
        fn method() {
            #[allow(unused)]
            let n = 1;
        }
        #[cfg(unknown)] const N: u8 = 1;
        #[cfg(unknown)] type Value;
    }
    #[cfg(unknown)]
    impl Holder {
        #[cfg(unknown)]
        #[allow(unused)]
        fn method() {
            match 0 {
                #[cfg(unknown)]
                0 => (),
                _ => (),
            }
        }
        #[cfg(unknown)] const N: u8 = 1;
        #[cfg(unknown)] type Value = u8;
    }
    /// Documentation precedes cfg; its line is the original scatter locator.
    #[cfg(any(unknown, feature = "disabled"))]
    fn work() {}
    #[cfg(any(unknown, feature = "disabled"))]
    struct Other;
}
